title: Operation.
officialText:
The post-fire smoke purge system shall be operated by manual controls that are part of the fire command
center, in accordance with Section 911, or fire alarm control unit when a fire command center is not required. Such control
center or panel shall display a graphic indicating the portions of the building served by each postfire smoke purge system.
When a system is zoned into areas of operation less than the entire building, each zone shall have an individual control. Fire
Department manual controls of postfire smoke purge systems shall not override the manual or automatic operation of the
smoke control system. Such Fire Department manual controls shall override the fire shutdown signal from the fire alarm
system.
